description.value: MATCH Eatery & Public House is a casual full-service restaurant and sports pub chain operated under the Gateway Casinos family, with locations across BC, Alberta, and Ontario. The Kamloops outpost serves an extensive menu of pub classics, pastas, burgers, wings, and pizzas alongside a full bar. Touring cyclists will find a welcoming sit-down atmosphere with takeout and delivery also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at matchpub.com/kamloops is live and confirms the Kamloops location at 1555 Versatile Dr with phone (250) 852-6555, matching the OSM address. Takeout and delivery are explicitly listed in the website navigation bar ('Takeout & Delivery', 'Pick Up'). No bike parking, bike racks, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists (250) 852-6555 for the Kamloops location — OSM could be updated.
OSM closing times for weekday/Sunday differ from those shown on the Kamloops page of the website; the website value should be treated as more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant and pub confirmed by a live website with current menus and Kamloops-specific contact details.
enrichment_extras.notes: Part of the Gateway Casinos restaurant group; corporate mailing address on the website footer (Burnaby, BC) is distinct from the Kamloops restaurant address.

wow_evidence: chain operated under the Gateway Casinos family, with locations across BC, Alberta, and Ontario
